text: DEFONEOS — MOD Defence Equipment & Support AI Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × MOD × DE&S MOD Defence Equipment & Support AI Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI governance of UK defence procurement — equipment acquisition analytics, through-life support optimisation, contract management intelligence, supplier performance monitoring, cost estimation automation, and DASA innovation pipeline governance. Cyber security model (CSM) certification. TEMPEST/EMSEC compliance. 200+ active defence standards governance across procurement and in-service. Supplier Supplier Performance & Risk Monitoring Defence supplier risk register. Contract performance indicator tracking. Supply chain resilience assessment. Strategic supplier oversight (BAE, Babcock, QinetiQ, Leonardo, Thales UK, MBDA). 3,000+ Tier 1 and Tier 2 defence suppliers monitored. Cost Estimation Cost Estimation & Assurance (CEA) MOD cost estimation methodology. Parametric and bottoms-up cost modelling. Whole-life cost analysis. Optimism bias correction. Independent cost assurance. 60+ major programme cost estimates reviewed annually by CEA team. Data DE&S Digital & Data Strategy Defence digital transformation. Cloud-first programme (MOD Cloud). Defence data exploitation. AI/ML integration across procurement lifecycle. Digital engineering and MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering). £1.2B+ digital investment programme. Parliamentary Defence Select Committee PAC Oversight Equipment Plan scrutiny. Major project cost overrun reporting. Single source contract efficiency assessment. DIO estate condition evidence.
